value.rationale: The interaction of a global alternating-depth leaf fluctuation and the local cherry count is a natural structural comparison in Catalan tree models. Their order-n mixed moment and product of means cancel to a nonzero 3/32 covariance despite both marginal variances being order n, yielding a sharp inverse-n correlation constant. The finite negative examples demonstrate that the limiting sign is not a trivial pointwise positivity law. The result is an exact motivated mixed invariant rather than a generic marginal recomputation.
